guide.instructions: Mandarin production vocab, English -> Chinese. The learner is a heritage speaker: handles everyday family conversation fluently but lacks adult vocabulary (work, money, health, news, opinions, abstract ideas). They read very little, so pinyin matters as much as characters. Skip anything a kid raised speaking Mandarin at home would know (family, food, daily routine, basic feelings). Target words an educated adult uses in conversation: 处理, 影响, 合同, 保险, 症状, 观点, 效率. The card front is English and must pin down ONE Chinese answer: add a disambiguating hint in parentheses when English is vague, e.g. 'to handle / deal with (a problem, a task)'. Hanzi: simplified. Pinyin: tone marks, words joined. Example: one natural spoken sentence in simplified characters, then pinyin, then English, e.g. '这件事我来处理。 zhè jiàn shì wǒ lái chǔlǐ: I'll handle this'. Notes: one line on usage: near-synonyms and how they differ (处理 vs 解决), register (spoken vs written/formal), common collocations. Empty if nothing useful.
guide.level: heritage speaker, fluent at home-level conversation, building adult vocabulary
